hard_rules: wow-service is the only framework dependency
one supported request maps to exactly one service operation
document notifications map only to their exact session overlay operation
LSP protocol specification transport framing capability and position behavior are exact frozen profiles
save notifications are observations and never filesystem or publication proof
no workspace edit execute command formatting rename file operation or settings mutation
code actions are advisory and contain no edit or command
client name capabilities workspace trust OS GitHub process and file identity never authorize operations or raise authority
source text remains bounded untrusted data and cannot create protocol frames methods capabilities or instructions
partial candidate conflict truncated OutcomeUnknown and NotEvaluated state is preserved
stdout contains protocol frames only and broken output never repeats service
no implicit workspace Git editor addon WoW network provider or credential discovery
no raw SQL filesystem source execution shell plugin model tool or lower owner access
no background work after response cancellation shutdown exit or transport loss
no Cargo Rust source or CI during documentation phase

required_before_first_rust_implementatio: implemented and frozen wow-service E7-A request result error session overlay authorization and canonical byte contracts
exact official LSP specification revision and conformance vectors
frozen stdio framing JSON-RPC initialization capability text-sync position diagnostic navigation action cancellation progress error shutdown and platform profiles
all method-to-service mapping source-boundary privacy backpressure broken-pipe and adversarial vectors
all canonical LSP request response notification error and framing bytes
all member and bundle SHA-256 values
